faq.a: Zoos, wildlife parks and aquariums looking to share their animals and mission with the Faunex community.
The scope and price of the partnership are defined together. Contact us to discuss your institution.

associations.title: Faunex for associations
associations.description: Nature walks, collection challenges and tailored events: introduce your members to biodiversity with Faunex.
associations.subtitle: Bring your members together around biodiversity. A walk, a challenge or a tailored event: turn wildlife observation into a shared adventure.
associations.imageAlt: A group observes and photographs a butterfly on a nature walk
associations.audienceDesc: Nature associations, local groups and outdoor clubs: share your passion and add a new dimension to your gatherings.

benefits.title: Bring members together
benefits.desc: A shared goal to connect, explore and exchange discoveries.

benefits.title: Learn through observation
benefits.desc: Discover local wildlife in a playful way while respecting animals and their habitats.

benefits.title: Keep a lasting memory
benefits.desc: Each participant keeps cards of their encounters in their Faunex.

associations.offerDesc: Choose a format or combine them. We define the programme and arrangements together around your group.

offers.title: Nature walks
offers.desc: An observation walk to discover local animals, photograph them and learn together.

offers.title: Collection challenges
offers.desc: A photographic challenge built around species or a theme: grow a bestiary without collecting or catching animals.

offers.title: Tailored events
offers.desc: A biodiversity day, an association gathering or a seasonal event designed around your project.

associations.finalTitle: Let’s create your next nature event
associations.finalDesc: Tell us about your association, location, proposed dates and expected group size.
associations.subject: Association event — Faunex

faq.q: Can we combine all three formats?
faq.a: Yes. A nature walk can include a photographic collection challenge and be part of a larger event.

faq.q: Do members need to know Faunex already?
faq.a: No. We plan the preparation with you around the group. Faunex is available on iPhone, Android and in a browser.
The budget and Faunex usage arrangements during the event depend on its format, duration and number of participants.
